cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: FarmHand NA is an offline livestock-health triage assistant for smallholder farmers and extension officers in northern Namibia, with English-first v1 support and a planned verified Oshiwambo written variety for the bilingual demo experience.

test_prompts.prompt: A cow has stopped eating, has a swollen left flank, keeps looking at its belly, and started getting worse a few hours after grazing. What are the most likely causes, what first actions are safe to take immediately, and what signs mean the farmer must seek urgent veterinary help?

A goat has diarrhea, is weak, and has pale inner eyelids during the dry season. List the most likely causes, the safest first actions a farmer can take at home, and the red-flag signs that require same-day referral.
